title: Reluctancy
summary: RELUCT'ANCY, n. [literally a straining or striving against.] Unwillingness; great opposition of mind; repugnance; with to or against; as, to undertake a war with reluctance. He has a great reluctance

inlines.v: RELUCT'ANCY, n. [literally a straining or striving against.] Unwillingness; great opposition of mind; repugnance; with to or against; as, to undertake a war with reluctance. He has a great reluctance to this measure.Bear witness, heav'n with what reluctancy her helpless innocence I doom to die.
